bounds.scope: Achieve at least 30% lower complete-workflow frontier input plus output for matched complex-task families through useful local Qwen work, with completion quality preserved. Archive conflicting live direction, preserve historical evidence and unrelated changes. Local tokens are effectively free for this objective.
permissions: read and edit relevant repository source, docs, directives and bounded experiment design
run focused tests and bounded offline verification after storage admission
run admitted pinned local Qwen inference for useful task work
run usage-complete frontier comparisons under the cumulative $1-per-task grant and existing tighter campaign limits
use only the explicitly authorized credential route at dispatch, without discovery, exposure or persistence
prohibited_actions: reset a stable task budget through a new run ID or ledger
count local tokens against frontier reduction or claim unused local drafts as useful work
promote zero-Qwen compression diagnostics to Qwen-assisted target proof
train or tune on sealed final material; capture or upload private task data without its scope and consent
activate production routing or publish without applicable authority
delete user data, other task artifacts, negative evidence or the only known-good model/data copy
expose credentials or inspect unrelated credential stores
claim representative utility from synthetic mechanics or incomplete usage

existing pinned local model packages after exact identity and runtime admission
bounds.authority_record: Owner: 30% frontier target, local tokens effectively free, $1 per task, autonomous bounded work without repeat permission. See docs/goal/wrench-token30/GOAL.md. Older grants do not reset or expand this budget.
